# Strategy selector corpus fixtures

These are verbatim committed public C5 units for the four selector candidates
and their inheritance closure. They exercise routing and accounting contracts;
they do not establish full-corpus retrieval quality or model/NPU benefits.
Original relative paths and unit provenance are retained.
